title: SPGR Story Context Brief v1
description: A compact per-story projection the harness refreshes at Act when a story's operative contract or rulings change. Dispatched units read it first and open a full artifact only for a section it cites. Derived and regenerable, never the source of truth.

operative_artifacts.description: Name -> repo-relative path (optionally with a cited section) of each artifact that currently governs the story

pinned_rulings.description: Strings and rulings a human or a gate has fixed, quoted so a unit does not re-derive them

open_conditions.description: Vertical conditions and review findings still to be satisfied before the story can advance
